sloka: तौ परिज्ञाततत्त्वार्थौ मया प्रीतिसमन्वितौ ।पृष्ठमारोप्य तं देशं प्रापितौ पुरुषर्षभौः ।। ५.३५.३१।।।।
transliteration: tau parijñātatattvārthau mayā prītisamanvitau ।pṛṣṭhamāropya taṁ deśaṁ prāpitau puruṣarṣabhauḥ ।। 5.35.31।।।।

translations.english: "I recognised the true status of both the mighty men who were filled with joy, placed them on my back, and reached the mountaintop.
